arrival.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
arrival.text: Welcome to Mars, Jin! First, fly to the space station and dock. Our radio antenna is broken. We must fix it before a dust storm reaches the base. Then we fly down to Mars.

docked.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
docked.text: You docked! Welcome to the space station. Go to the window console. Take your time, and check each machine before you change it.

brief.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
brief.text: The radio antenna is broken. Look at the screen to find the broken part. Turn off power to just that part. Keep the station power on. Then fix it and test it.

relay.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
relay.text: The radio works! The base can hear us again. Now pack your kit. Then check the door to the lander.

lander.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
lander.text: You are in the lander. Check the landing path. Check the fuel and seat belts. Then we can fly down to the base.

descent.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
descent.text: Here we go! The base is waiting below. The computer is steering us down. Hold on tight!

touchdown.speaker: Elena Reyes · Commander
touchdown.text: We landed! Welcome to Meridian base, Jin. Great flying. Tomorrow a big dust storm is coming. Your next job is to keep the base safe.
